name: @nothumanwork/bot-workspace
description: Local-first bot runtime, AI SDK integration, and web application

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nothumanwork/bot && npm run build --workspace @nothumanwork/bot-ai-sdk && npm run build --workspace @nothumanwork/bot-ui
scripts.build:native: npm run build:adapter && npm run build:native --workspace @nothumanwork/bot-ui -- --out ../../dist/bot-web
scripts.test:native: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:adapter && npm run test:native --workspace @nothumanwork/bot-ui && node --import tsx --test test/native-browser.test.ts
scripts.build:ui: npm run build --workspace @nothumanwork/bot-ai-sdk && npm run build --workspace @nothumanwork/bot-ui
scripts.check: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:adapter && npm run check --workspace @nothumanwork/bot && npm run check --workspace @nothumanwork/bot-ai-sdk && npm run check --workspace @nothumanwork/bot-ui && npm run check:integration
scripts.test: npm run build:adapter && npm run test --workspace @nothumanwork/bot && npm run test --workspace @nothumanwork/bot-ai-sdk && npm run test --workspace @nothumanwork/bot-ui && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:adapter && node --import tsx --test test/workspace.test.ts test/adapter-runtime.test.ts
scripts.dev: npm run build:adapter && npm run dev --workspace @nothumanwork/bot-ui
